title: Result
description: The outcome of one Task. Written by the Worker (succeeded/failed) or by the Orchestrator when the Worker stopped mid-Task (lost). A Worker never claims a Task was Blocked — that verdict belongs to the test harness.

worker.description: Pod name of the Worker that took the Task.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the Scenario (or tool) process; 128+N when killed by signal N, e.g. 137 for SIGKILL. Null when lost.

output.description: Tail of the process's combined output.
